title: Batch equivalence for free inputs
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, and let $M$ be a natural number. There is a bijection between batches of $M$ assignments to the coordinates outside $P$ and batches of $M$ sign vectors of length equal to the number of coordinates outside $P$, obtained by converting each assignment to its sign-vector representation coordinatewise.
